name: runner: a project with a small plate (20 × 10 × 2) and a large one (60 × 30 × 2), the large one active
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); const plate = (L, W) => m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [L, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [L, 0], b: [L, W] }, { kind: 'line', a: [L, W], b: [0, W] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, W], b: [0, 0] }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 2 })); }); plate(20, 10); m.actions.change('op.macro', (p) => { p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id).name = 'Small'; }); await sleep(800); await m.run('newPart'); await sleep(400); m.actions.change('op.macro', (p) => { p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id).name = 'Large'; }); plate(60, 30); await sleep(1200); return JSON.stringify({ parts: m.state.doc.project.parts.length, active: m.active()?.name, faces: m.state.partEntry?.faces?.length }); })()

name: runner: two cavities of the large plate on a symmetric runner fill together; the table, imbalance and runner volume show
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('plasticsStudy'); await sleep(300); const group = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="plCavities"]')); const famBox = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-toggle^="plFamily."]')); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('plCavities', '2'); await sleep(200); await m.actions.pmCommand('pl.runRunner'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !m.mfg.plastics.runner(); i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(300); const r = m.mfg.plastics.runner(); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.pl-cavity-table tr').length; return JSON.stringify({ group, famBox, n: r?.cavities.length, full: r?.cavities.every((c) => c.complete), balanced: r && r.imbalance < 0.05, rows, share: r && r.runnerShare > 0 && r.runnerShare < 0.5, v: r && [r.imbalance, r.spruePressure] }); })()

name: runner: a family mould (1 large + the small part) is out of balance; balancing widens the large one’s branch and brings it under 5 %
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const small = m.state.doc.project.parts.find((p) => p.name === 'Small'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('plCavities', '1'); m.actions.pmToggle('plFamily.' + small.id, true); await sleep(200); await m.actions.pmCommand('pl.runRunner'); await sleep(300); const raw = m.mfg.plastics.runner(); const rawImb = raw.imbalance; await m.actions.pmCommand('pl.balance'); await sleep(300); const b = m.mfg.plastics.runner(); const st = m.mfg.plastics.study(); return JSON.stringify({ n: raw.cavities.length, unbalanced: rawImb > 0.15, better: b.imbalance < 0.05, wider: b.cavities[0].branchDiameter > b.cavities[1].branchDiameter, saved: st.runner.branches?.length === 2, steps: Boolean(document.querySelector('.pl-cavity-table')), v: [rawImb, b.imbalance, b.cavities.map((c) => c.branchDiameter)] }); })()

name: runner: the layout on the model (cavity boxes, runner, gates)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('isometric'); await m.run('zoomFit'); await sleep(900); document.querySelector('.pl-cavity-table')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(200); return /예기치 않은 오류|Unexpected error/.test(document.body.innerText) ? 'crashed' : 'ok'; })()
